notes.title: Zoo Seeker Update 01/17/2022
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!
As of today, we have updated Zoo Seeker with the following improvements:

1. Tutorial
By selecting the「Tutorial」button in the stage, you can see how to play Zoo Seeker with a mouse, or with a game pad. 

2. New Theme
You can now explore「Castle」, a new theme.

3. You can now directly find the game menu in the main screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41580120/dcf015153ad2f5ce74bb376ecff1366fe77f8e3b.jpg[/img]

4. The hint system has been partly modified.

5. Overall game balance has been improved.

We deeply appreciate your interest in Zoo Seeker, and will keep up the hard work to meet your expectations.

notes.title: Zoo Seeker Update - 12/24/2021
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that 「Zoo Seeker」 has been updated today!
Players can create and upload their own maps, share them on the Steam Workshop, and also play maps that other people have created. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41580120/cd31dccd82eed2e609e0a530db252fff30e1c944.jpg[/img]

We deeply appreciate your interest, and your time on playing 「Zoo Seeker」.
Feedbacks will be collected from around the world during the Early Access, and use to improve the game before full release.

We will keep up the hard work to meet your expectations.
